Recorded claim:
`TreeViewTableBody.connectedCallback()` initializes `role="treegrid"` and `tabIndex=0`; cached cells do not need role reassignment on each `fillRow()`. Still reset recycled dynamic twisty visibility, label, and `ariaExpanded`; process `column.checkbox` before `viewRow.getText(column.id)`. [Task 1]
